situations.title: 화상 초기 사정
situations.tagline: I spilled boiling water all over my arm and chest.
situations.brief: 화상의 원인·범위·깊이를 신속히 평가하세요.
keyPhrases: How did the burn happen and what caused it?
I'm going to look at how large and deep the burn is.
Let me remove anything covering the burned skin gently.

situations.title: TBSA 9의 법칙 설명
situations.tagline: How much of my body actually got burned?
situations.brief: 9의 법칙으로 체표면적을 추정하고 환자에게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: We estimate how much skin is burned using body regions.
Each arm counts as about nine percent of your body.
This helps us decide how much fluid you need.
goals: 추정 목적과 결과를 이해하기 쉽게 설명한다

situations.title: 화상 깊이 구분
situations.tagline: Some spots hurt a lot but others feel numb—why?
situations.brief: 표재·부분·전층 화상을 통증 차이로 구분해 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Deeper burns can actually feel numb because of nerve damage.
The very painful areas are usually more shallow burns.
I'm checking each area for depth and sensation.

situations.title: 초기 냉각·세척
situations.tagline: It's still burning—can you cool it down?
situations.brief: 지속 세척으로 냉각하되 과냉각을 피하도록 관리·설명하세요.
keyPhrases: We'll rinse the burn with cool water to stop the heat.
We avoid ice so we don't damage the skin further.
Tell me if you start feeling cold or shivery.

situations.title: 통증 척도·기전 청취
situations.tagline: The stove caught fire while I was cooking.
situations.brief: 열원·노출·밀폐공간 등 기전과 통증 척도를 청취하세요.
keyPhrases: What caused the burn and how long were you exposed?
Were you in an enclosed, smoky space?
On a scale of zero to ten, how bad is the pain?
goals: 통증 강도를 사정하고 흡입 위험을 선별한다

situations.title: 흡입 손상 의심
situations.tagline: My throat feels tight and my voice sounds strange after the fire.
situations.brief: 안면 화상·그을음 환자의 기도를 조기에 사정하고 삽관 필요성을 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: I need to look inside your mouth and throat.
Has your voice changed or does it hurt to swallow?
We may need to protect your airway early to be safe.
goals: 그을음·쉰목소리 등 기도 손상 징후를 사정한다
기도 부종 진행 위험을 조기에 판단·보고한다

situations.title: 대면적 화상 수액소생
situations.tagline: Why am I getting so much fluid through this IV?
situations.brief: Parkland 공식과 소변량 목표로 대면적 화상 수액소생을 관리·설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Large burns lose fluid, so we replace it carefully.
We measure your urine to make sure the fluids are enough.
Tell me if you feel thirsty or very tired.

situations.title: 화학 화상
situations.tagline: Some chemical splashed on my skin and it keeps stinging.
situations.brief: 원인물질을 확인하고 중화 없이 지속 세척으로 화학 화상을 처치하세요.
keyPhrases: What chemical was it, and do you know its name?
We'll rinse it with lots of water, not neutralize it.
Keep rinsing—this removes the chemical from your skin.

situations.title: 전기 화상 심전도 감시
situations.tagline: The electric shock threw me back—my heart feels weird.
situations.brief: 전기 화상 환자의 부정맥을 심전도로 감시하고 입출구 창상을 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Electrical burns can affect your heart, so we're monitoring it.
Let me find the entry and exit wounds on your body.
Tell me if your heart races or you feel dizzy.

situations.title: 순환성 전층화상
situations.tagline: My arm feels really tight and my fingers are tingling.
situations.brief: 사지를 조이는 전층화상의 압박·순환장애를 사정하고 가피절개를 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: The burn is circling your arm and may cut off circulation.
I'm checking the pulse and feeling in your fingers.
We may need to release the pressure with a small cut.

situations.title: 소아 화상 학대 감별
situations.tagline: He got burned in the bath—it was just an accident.
situations.brief: 소아 화상의 대칭·경계 패턴을 사정해 학대 가능성을 신중히 감별하세요.
keyPhrases: Can you walk me through exactly how the burn happened?
I'm noting the shape and edges of the burn carefully.
We check every child's injury to keep them safe.
goals: 대칭·명확한 경계 등 의심 패턴을 사정한다

situations.title: 고령 화상 동반질환
situations.tagline: I have diabetes and heart trouble—will this burn be okay?
situations.brief: 얇은 피부와 기저질환을 고려해 고령 화상 환자를 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Older skin is thinner, so burns can be deeper than they look.
Your diabetes may slow healing, so we'll watch it closely.
What medicines and health problems do you have?
goals: 얇은 피부로 인한 깊이 과소평가를 방지한다

situations.title: 안면·수부 화상 기능
situations.tagline: My hands are burned—will I be able to use them again?
situations.brief: 기능 부위(안면·수부) 화상을 사정하고 화상센터 전원을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: Burns to your hands need special care to keep function.
We'll refer you to a burn center for the best outcome.
We'll keep your fingers positioned and covered properly.
goals: 기능 부위 화상의 깊이와 범위를 사정한다
화상센터 전원 기준에 따라 이송을 조율한다

situations.title: 언어장벽 화상
situations.tagline: Nóng... axit... không nói được tiếng Anh.
situations.brief: 언어장벽 환자의 원인물질·노출시간을 통역과 함께 확보하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm getting an interpreter to help us communicate.
What caused the burn—heat, chemical, or electricity?
How long was your skin in contact with it?

situations.title: 화상센터 이송 기준
situations.tagline: They said I need to go to a special burn hospital—why?
situations.brief: 전원 기준을 설명하고 이송 전 처치를 완료하세요.
keyPhrases: A burn center has specialists for burns like yours.
Before transfer, we'll cover the burns and manage your pain.
We'll keep you warm and send your records with you.
goals: 피복·진통·보온 등 이송 전 처치를 완료한다

situations.title: 기도 화상 부종 진행
situations.tagline: My breathing is getting harder and my throat is swelling.
situations.brief: 진행하는 기도 부종을 인지하고 조기 삽관을 준비·보조하세요.
keyPhrases: Your airway is swelling, so we need to secure it now.
We're going to place a breathing tube before it closes.
Try to stay calm—this will help you breathe safely.
goals: 진행하는 기도 부종·폐쇄 위험을 즉시 인지한다

situations.title: 대면적 화상 저혈량 쇼크
situations.tagline: I feel so weak and my heart is racing.
situations.brief: 대면적 화상의 저혈량 쇼크를 대량 수액과 소변량 목표로 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Large burns cause heavy fluid loss, so we're giving fluids fast.
Your urine output tells us if the fluids are working.
We're watching your pressure and heart rate closely.
goals: 대량 수액과 소변량 목표로 소생을 관리한다

situations.title: 일산화탄소/시안 중독
situations.tagline: I have a splitting headache and feel confused after the fire.
situations.brief: 정상 SpO2 함정을 인지하고 고농도 산소로 CO/시안 중독을 처치하세요.
keyPhrases: The pulse oximeter can read normal even with this poisoning.
We're giving you high-flow oxygen right away.
Confusion and headache after a fire are important warning signs.
goals: 정상 SpO2 함정을 인지하고 중독을 의심한다

situations.title: 흉부 원주형 화상 환기장애
situations.tagline: My chest is so tight I can't take a full breath.
situations.brief: 흉부를 조이는 원주형 화상의 환기장애를 사정하고 가피절개를 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: The burn around your chest is restricting your breathing.
We may make small cuts in the burned skin to let it expand.
This will help your chest move so you can breathe.

situations.title: 전기화상 횡문근융해
situations.tagline: My urine looks dark like tea and my muscles ache badly.
situations.brief: 근붕괴로 인한 고칼륨·신손상 위험을 사정하고 수액·감시를 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Dark urine can mean your muscles are breaking down.
We're giving fluids to protect your kidneys.
We're watching your potassium and heart rhythm closely.

situations.title: 화상 SBAR 인계
situations.tagline: Burn center is on the line—give me the full report.
situations.brief: TBSA·수액량·기도 상태를 SBAR로 화상센터에 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: This is a 35-year-old with 30 percent TBSA burns.
We started Parkland fluids and urine output is adequate.
The airway is patent but we're watching for swelling.
goals: 기도 상태와 이송 준비를 명확히 인계한다
